name: Fat Pack | 1.5g Preroll | Mocha Runtz
description: Fat J: 1.5 Gram Preroll - a half gram better. This flavorful cross offers candy-like fruit and berry notes thanks to terpenes like Limonene, Pinene, and Caryophyllene. Euphoric and creative with moderate body relaxation, LA Pop Rocks x Purple Push Pop is upbeat and fun. It’s a strain that pairs perfectly with good company or artistic vibes.
